resolution.note: pruneMergedLanes skips ship records younger than PRUNE_GRACE_MS (30 min); test/hook/stop-merged-lane.test.ts covers fresh vs aged

title: Lane start keeps a just-merged lane worktree for a grace period
body:
Outcome: krn lane start does not prune a merged lane worktree whose ship record is younger than a grace period, so a lane session still running there keeps its cwd.
Why: 2026-11-16 the t-vs35jd7 and t-4k4yjzj lanes' Stop hooks failed (spawn ENOENT, run.stdout undefined) because another lane's krn lane start pruned their just-merged worktrees while the sessions were still ending.
Proof: node --test test/hook/stop-merged-lane.test.ts: a fresh ship is kept, one older than PRUNE_GRACE_MS is pruned.
